findings.sentence: Koah announced a $20.5M Series A led by Theory Ventures on 24 Feb 2026, and Crustdata's indexed record lists the same round.
Koah's release names Nic Baird as Co-Founder and CEO; his indexed profile lists him as Co-Founder at Koah without the CEO title.
findings.limitation: The CEO title rests on the company's statement; the indexed profile shows only Co-Founder.

findings.sentence: TechCrunch reported that Forerunner led Koah's seed round with South Park Commons and Andrew Karam participating, and Crustdata's indexed record lists a $5M seed dated 7 Sep 2025 led by Forerunner.

Koah's release says the Series A brings its total funding to more than $26 million; Crustdata's indexed record totals $25.5M from the $20.5M Series A and the $5M seed, with no amount recorded for a 2024 pre-seed.
findings.limitation: The indexed total leaves out the 2024 pre-seed amount, so it cannot confirm the company's figure.
findings.question: How much was the 2024 pre-seed? The release's total of more than $26 million exceeds the $25.5M in recorded rounds.

findings.sentence: TechCrunch reported on 7 Sep 2025 that Koah had recently raised $5 million in seed funding.
